title: Time preservation under state coding
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Turing machine over the binary alphabet with exactly one work tape, and let $x$ and $y$ be binary strings and $t\in\mathbb{N}$. The machine obtained by relabelling the states of $M$ by the canonical finite state set with the same number of states computes $y$ from $x$ within $t$ steps if and only if $M$ does.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
$hk$ identifies its work-tape count as one
